turns.user_utterance: What do I do if the ATM didn't give me the correct amount I withdrew? I pulled out 30 pounds and the ATM gave me 10 pounds.
turns.assistant_response: I’m sorry about that—if the ATM gave you the wrong amount (you withdrew £30 but received £10), the right help topic is **wrong amount of cash received**. Please tell me: did the full withdrawal of £30 get taken from your balance/receipt, and was the ATM able to dispense the remaining £20 (or did you only get £10 total)?
